name: linea_theme
script: (function(){var MOON='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3a6 6 0 0 0 9 9 9 9 0 1 1-9-9Z"/></svg>';var SUN='<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2"/><path d="M12 20v2"/><path d="m4.93 4.93 1.41 1.41"/><path d="m17.66 17.66 1.41 1.41"/><path d="M2 12h2"/><path d="M20 12h2"/><path d="m6.34 17.66-1.41 1.41"/><path d="m19.07 4.93-1.41 1.41"/></svg>';function syncIcon(t){var b=document.querySelector('[data-theme-toggle]');if(b)b.innerHTML=(t==='dark'?SUN:MOON);}function cur(){return document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');}function set(t){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);try{localStorage.setItem('linea-theme',t)}catch(e){}syncIcon(t);}function apply(t){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);syncIcon(t);}var s=null;try{s=localStorage.getItem('linea-theme')}catch(e){}apply(s||'light');document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){syncIcon(cur());});document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var el=e.target.closest('[data-theme-toggle]');if(el){e.preventDefault();set(cur()==='dark'?'light':'dark')}});})();
